parsed.name: 离散PI控制器
parsed.description: 一种执行比例-积分反馈调节的数字控制单元，根据设定值与测量反馈之间的偏差计算控制输出，并带有积分防饱和处理。可用于实验室中的温度、位置、光功率或其他过程量的闭环稳定控制。
parsed.description_en: A digital control unit that performs proportional-integral feedback control. It computes a control output from the error between a setpoint and a measured feedback value, with anti-windup handling for the integral term. It is suitable for closed-loop stabilization of temperature, position, optical power, or other process variables in laboratory setups.

actions.description_en: Calculate the PI control output from the current measured value.

actions.description_en: Read the controller's monitored values or probe readings.
